metadata.title: Discovering Your Ancestors Using Probate Records- James Tanner
metadata.author: BYU Library Family History Center
metadata.shortDescription:
In this Sunday class, James Tanner teaches how to research using Probate Records. 
For more information: https://familyhistory.lib.byu.edu/virtual-classes/discovering-your-ancestors-using-probate-records
